contexts.text: Love without holy fear is as it were an insipid affair, or like food in which there is no... flavour...
Salt unsalted () = truth without the longing for good. ( = a longing from some other love than what is genuine. AC 10300:2.)
Without this fear, love is insipid and cutaneous...
(The representations used by evil Spirits) were insipid, devoid of an idea.
